name: Dominion Gleam
description: Raise a bright glow about the user that steadies the stance and lends each movement an air of command.

name: Command Ray
description: Point two fingers and loose a ray that stings the target and draws their eyes to the user.

name: Raised Hand
description: Lift an open hand ringed in light to turn a blow aside as a ruler waves back a petitioner.

name: Command Flare
description: Hold a hard flare over a foe's head and weigh down their qi until their knees begin to bend.

name: Crown Guard
description: Set a ring of hard light about the head and shoulders that stops blows aimed at the crown.

name: Edict Beam
description: Fire a straight beam from the brow with a force that leaves no room for argument.

name: Throne Radiance
description: Fill the field with a radiance so heavy that foes in it are burned and pressed toward the ground.

name: Dominion Flare
description: Burst the whole field outward in one flare that scorches the ground and throws back all standing on it.

name: Sovereign Blaze
description: Call down a blaze of command light that sears a wide ground and breaks the will of those it touches.

name: Polish Gleam
description: Rub the qi smooth over the forearms until they shine like silver and shed weak blows.

name: Polished Glint
description: Flash a mirror glint from the palm that reflects into the target's eyes and stings.

name: Dawn Turn
description: Turn a half circle on the back foot in a flash that puts the foe's blow behind.

name: Mirror Answer
description: Catch a thrown missile or ray on a polished plane and send it back along the same line.

name: Silver Parry
description: Knock a blow aside with a silvered forearm and rap the exposed ribs on the return.

name: Echo Flash
description: Flash twice from two mirrors so the foe cannot tell which brightness is the true source.

name: Polished Return
description: Raise a wall of polished light that throws every ray and missile back on its sender.

name: Returned Radiance
description: Gather the force of a hard blow into the mirror field and loose it outward in a wide flash.

name: Dawn Reversal
description: Turn a heavy attack back on the attacker in a mirror of bright dawn so that they take its full force.

name: Glare Spark
description: Spark a hard glare an inch before the eyes so the target blinks and loses the moment.

name: Blind Flick
description: Flick a point of blinding light at the target's brow so that dark spots swim across their sight.

name: Dazzle Step
description: Step inside a burst of glare so the foe's eyes cannot follow the body to its new place.

name: Eye Guard
description: Wave a hand of light before the user's own eyes to turn a flash or flung grit aside.

name: Whiteout Flash
description: Flood the front with such white light that no foe in it can see for several breaths.

name: Glare Snare
description: Bind a foe's gaze to a point of light so that they cannot turn away from it.

name: Blur Beam
description: Loose a beam that smears into a streak so the target cannot judge where it will land.

name: Dazzle Deluge
description: Pour a deluge of shifting light on a wide patch so every foe in it is blinded and burned.

name: Sightbreak
description: Hold the eyes of one foe in a lance of light until their sense of place is gone and they stumble.

name: Blinding Crown
description: Set a crown of burning white on a foe's head that blinds them and presses their qi down together.

name: Aureole Touch
description: Rest a ringed hand on an ally's wound so the glow closes torn skin and eases bleeding.

name: Ring Shield
description: Hold a ring of light round a wounded ally so that stray blows lose their weight.

name: Mending Mote
description: Press a mote of warm light into the user's own bruise to take the worst of the pain away.

name: Sinew Light
description: Run light along a torn muscle and tendon of an ally until the fibres draw back together.

name: Aureole Cleanse
description: Pass the aureole slowly over an ally and burn out taint from the wound and the blood.

name: Pulse Lamp
description: Beat a lamp of light against an ally's heart to lift their strength after a long labour.

name: Aureole Bloom
description: Open the ring wide into a bloom of warm light that mends every ally who stands within it.

name: Halo Rekindle
description: Lay the halo over one whose pulse has just been cut and rekindle it within a short window; the long dead are not returned.

name: Dawnmend
description: Pour a full dawn of healing light into one ally to close even a grave wound and burn out its taint.

name: Lance Mote
description: Pinch a mote of daylight to a point and flick it straight at the target.

name: Day Step
description: Take a step along a ray of daylight to close the gap before the foe has set.

name: Thrust Glint
description: Throw a glint in a straight line that pricks through thin cloth to the skin.

name: Shaft Brace
description: Brace the arm and spine with a straight rod of light so the next thrust carries more weight.

name: Daylight Pierce
description: Drive a hard rod of daylight through the guard and into the shoulder behind it.

name: Lance Veer
description: Veer a blow off the shaft and send the point on a short thrust through the opening.

name: Gathered Spear
description: Gather the field into one great spear of light and drive it through plate and the body behind it.

name: Lance Cascade
description: Break the spear into a cascade of lances that fall one after another in a line.

name: Dayspear
description: Cast the whole day into a single spear whose point pierces defences and the life they guard.

name: Shown Ray
description: Show the ray plainly before it flies and let it strike anyway.

name: Honest Step
description: Step straight at the foe in full light with no feint and no cover.

name: Naked Guard
description: Hold a plain bright guard before the chest with no trick behind it.

name: Show Flash
description: Flash light through a foe's stance to show the weak point and break the focus of the blow.

name: Open Brace
description: Brace the body in open light so the user bears pain without flinching.

name: Naked Beam
description: Fire a clear beam the foe sees in full and still cannot turn.

name: Stripping Glare
description: Pour light over a hidden foe to strip their cover and cancel the techniques that hide them.

name: Bare Radiance
description: Burst the field in an unshaded blaze that gives every foe in it nowhere to turn.

name: Nothing Hidden
description: Seal all concealing and warding techniques inside a wide field while a naked blaze burns the foes in it.

name: Ray Stride
description: Step on a ray of light so that the body arrives with the flash.

name: Fleet Glint
description: Loose a glint so fleet that the foe's eyes catch it only after it has struck.

name: Haste Glow
description: Wake a glow in the legs and arms that brings quickness for the next few moves.

name: Slip Beam
description: Slip along a beam of light out of the path of a thrust and push the blade wide.

name: Streak Cut
description: Pass the foe on a streak of light and cut across the ribs with an edged hand.

name: Afterimage
description: Leave a bright afterimage of the body in place and step away from it at once.

name: Ray Run
description: Run on a long band of light across open ground without a pause in the stride.

name: Light Lash
description: Cross the gap as a lash of light and strike on arrival with the full speed behind the blow.

name: Blinding Rush
description: Rush through a blinded front and strike the first body that the light shows.

name: Radiant Phase
description: Become a passing beam and pass through a guard or a wall to strike from behind it.

name: Mirror Focus
description: Curve the light before the palm into a small bowl that gathers heat to one point.

name: Spark Glass
description: Gather the glints in a small glass of light and fire the hot point at the target.

name: Heat Glint
description: Touch the foe with a fist whose knuckles carry a burning glint.

name: Focus Beam
description: Gather the glints into one hard beam and burn through leather and plate on a single spot.

name: Mirror Shell
description: Wrap the body in a shell of polished light that turns the heat of fire and ray alike.

name: Scorch Trace
description: Draw a hot line of light across the ground that no foe can cross without burning.

name: Burning Point
description: Hold the great mirror on a single spot until the point burns through to the core.

name: Gathered Heat
description: Gather the heat of the whole field and let it fall on a wide patch at once.

name: Ashen Point
description: Burn one chosen point to ash in an instant so that no guard or hide stands between it and the flame.

name: Ring Gleam
description: Hold a thin ring of gleam round the body that takes the sting from glancing blows.

name: Radiant Catch
description: Catch a blow in the ring and let it slide round the body without a jolt.

name: Guard Pulse
description: Pulse light through the arms and legs so the guard holds steady against a hard blow.

name: Light Drink
description: Let the ring drink a blow's force and convert part of it into a steady glow.

name: Wide Aureole
description: Widen the ring so that it covers every ally who stands beside the user.

name: Bright Aegis
description: Throw up a hard bastion of light that stops a rush and dazzles those who strike it.

name: Drinking Halo
description: Spread the halo to drink the blows of many strikes and hold the brightness in reserve.

name: Weight Bloom
description: Turn a crushing blow into a bloom of light that bursts outward and shoves the attackers back.

name: Full Aureole
description: Take a blow whole into the ring and convert its weight into steady light for the user to keep.

name: Beacon Spark
description: Set a spark in the air and feel any body that crosses the glow it casts.

name: Guiding Glow
description: Wake a guiding glow before an ally so that they keep their footing and their direction.

name: Keeper Ray
description: Loose a plain ray from the beacon hand at whatever comes near the standing light.

name: Standing Light
description: Plant a pillar of light that stays in place and turns blows aimed at those beside it.

name: Marking Flare
description: Throw a flare onto a hidden foe so that every ally can see where they stand.

name: Beacon Call
description: Raise the beacon to a bright call that lifts the courage and speed of nearby allies.

name: Lantern Link
description: Make the whole field a lantern in which each ally feels where the others stand.

name: Rallying Radiance
description: Spread a rallying radiance over the allies that steels their strength and softens blows on them.

name: Standing Beacon
description: Raise a great beacon that strengthens every ally in its light and presses down every foe.
